text:
Last lesson you worked with a demo gripper, but when you use your real prosthesis you will connect it to a servo block, not a gripper block.

Do you think that working with a demo gripper block can still be useful when you are designing a prosthesis? What can it be useful for?

If it's not useful at all, why not?

Next lesson, you'll connect your prosthesis prototype to the servo.

If you have time, start thinking about how you will do it.

Use the sketch tool or sketch on paper to sketch how you will connect it. Try to show how the prosthesis will look at different positions of the servo.

(If you sketch on paper, remember to upload a picture so you can use it next class!)
